coordinateSystem.origin: x0/z0 body envelope centre, y0 lowest frame point excluding lights and tether

publishedEnvelope.excludes: External floodlights; the modeled short tether also extends beyond the envelope

configuration: Standard ROV with two external floodlights in the manual common deployed working position. No optional cage, manipulator or sonar.

facts.thrusterDescription: Eight vectored C-MOTOR 2.0 thrusters; shown as fore/aft upper/lower corner pairs. Angles approximated from imagery.
facts.battery: Rear removable battery compartment; website nominal 300Wh, manual 302.4Wh.
facts.lights: Two external folding LED floodlights, 2 x 4000 lumens total 8000 lumens.
facts.camera: Forward integrated camera; 4K and 12MP claimed in official overview.

Camera, external folding lights and motor family.

limitations: Reference-based procedural visualization, not manufacturer CAD.
Published no-light overall envelope is the only dimensional anchor. Individual parts, motor axes, lamp spacing, battery split and fasteners are visually approximated.
Lamp brightness is metadata only, not a calibrated lighting simulation.
Removable battery is represented as a selectable group, without verified internal geometry or service clearances.
